description: A helper class providing methods to handle nullability checks and transitions to nullable reference types in C# projects.

classes.name: NRT
classes.description: Static helper class for handling nullability checks and code migration to nullable reference types.

methods.name: ThrowOnNull
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException if a null reference is encountered, used during nullable reference type migration.

methods.name: ThrowOnNull<TResult>
methods.description: Generic method that throws InvalidOperationException, used during transition to nullable reference types.

methods.name: ThrowOnNull<TResult, TType>
methods.description: Generic method that throws InvalidOperationException, indicating a specific type must not be null.
